title: Jen Psaki attacked Trump's mental health focus with these three unhinged demands that will make you sick
text:
The Left never lets a good crisis go to waste.
They’ll use any tragedy to push their radical agenda on the American people.
And Jen Psaki fired back at Trump with three demands after the Minneapolis church shooting that will make you sick.
Former Biden Press Secretary goes to war with Trump over shooting response A transgender shooter targeted a Catholic church, leaving families devastated and a community in mourning.
Instead of allowing people to grieve, former Biden Press Secretary Jen Psaki decided this was the perfect moment to launch a political attack from her MSNBC perch.
Psaki used her television show to fire back at the Trump administration’s focus on mental health, making three specific demands that revealed exactly where her priorities lie.
When White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt faced questions about the administration’s response, YouTuber Brandon Tatum asked a reasonable question about addressing the mental health crisis behind these shootings.
"I want to ask you the question of, we know that it’s not a gun thing. Any rational person knows it’s not a gun thing. We know it’s a mental health issue. So I want to know from you, what does President Trump and the White House going to do to address mental health issues around the country associated with these shootings?" Tatum said.
That’s when Psaki lost it.
"Well, first off, Brandon, feels like someone in the White House may have written that question for you, but it is definitely a gun thing," Psaki shot back on her MSNBC show.
She couldn’t handle someone challenging her narrative, so she immediately attacked the questioner’s credibility.
But Psaki was just getting started with her political grandstanding.
Psaki attacks Trump’s mental health focus as "bizarre strategy" Instead of acknowledging the obvious mental health crisis driving these tragedies, Psaki doubled down on her gun control talking points.
She dismissed the Trump administration’s focus on SSRI medication – drugs that have been linked to violent behavior in multiple studies – calling it "a little bit of a bizarre strategy."
Think about that for a second.
The Trump administration wants to investigate whether psychiatric drugs might be contributing to mass violence, and Psaki calls that "bizarre."
What’s really bizarre is attacking people for wanting to understand the root causes of these horrific acts.
Psaki then made three specific demands of the Trump administration that exposed her true agenda.
First, she demanded universal background checks for gun sales, claiming "more than 80 percent of the country supports them."
Second, she insisted Trump should support "making it harder for people with mental illnesses to purchase a gun."
And you know just how Psaki and her ilk would likely define mental illness.
Simply wanting a semi-automatic rifle that has a standard capacity magazine would be grounds for denying you your Second Amendment rights if Psaki had her way.
Third, she called for "a ban on assault weapons when the majority of the country does."
The good news is, the only way a majority of the country would ever support that is if they were asked in an extremely misleading way that made them think they were being asked about machine guns.
The bad news is that’s exactly how anti-gun media and pollsters try to frame it for the American people every time they ask.
Worse, that’s the same kind of false narrative that the anti-freedom voices in Trump’s first administration succeeded in using to impose enhanced restrictions on gun owners during his first term following the shooting at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas.
But notice the pattern about Psaki’s demands.
Every single one involves restricting the rights of law-abiding Americans.
Not a word about actually treating the mental health crisis that’s driving these tragedies.
The media’s sick obsession with exploiting tragedy Here’s what’s really happening – and this should make you furious.
The moment a tragedy occurs, the Left’s media machine immediately springs into action to exploit the pain and suffering for political gain.
They don’t care about the victims or their families.
They don’t want to address the real causes of violence in our society.
All they care about is using dead bodies to push their anti-Second Amendment agenda.
Psaki even had the audacity to attack prayer as an insufficient response to tragedy.
"And what I said yesterday and will say again now, though, is that prayer alone is not enough to prevent and end the crisis of gun violence in America," she declared.
This is the same crowd that spent years attacking Americans for their faith, and now they’re using a church shooting to diminish the power of prayer.
The hypocrisy is breathtaking.
While Trump’s team is trying to understand why troubled individuals turn to violence – looking at everything from social media radicalization to psychiatric medications – Psaki wants to ignore all of that and just grab more guns from law-abiding citizens.
And you know what the most disgusting part is?
Psaki is doing this from the comfort of her MSNBC studio, collecting a fat paycheck to spread propaganda while real families are dealing with unimaginable grief.
She’s turned tragedy into a ratings opportunity and political weapon.
The Trump administration is absolutely right to focus on the mental health crisis and the factors that drive people to commit these horrific acts.
But the media doesn’t want solutions – they want political victories.
And they’ll use any tragedy, even the targeting of a church, to get them.
